name: CHAIN THE LOCK ~Okinawa ni Nemuru Zaihou~
original_name: CHAIN THE LOCK～沖縄に眠る財宝～
source:
An event has taken place in Okinawa that has become the topic of conversation lately, and the people living in Okinawa have a new and strange rumor.

They say that it's true that somewhere on the island rests a treasure.

This game takes the game format and mixes it with fiction and actual events in Okinawa.
Human relationships add to the mystery to make this the greatest masterpiece of the CHAIN game series.
Chains are born as the bravery and tragedy lie shrouded in mystery.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ041699.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
最近，冲绳发生了一件成为人们谈论的话题的事件，居住在冲绳的人们有了一个新的奇怪的传闻。

他们说岛上的某个地方确实埋藏着宝藏。

该游戏采用游戏形式，并将其与冲绳的虚构和真实事件混合在一起。
人际关系增添了神秘感，使之成为CHAIN游戏系列中最伟大的杰作。
当勇敢和悲剧笼罩在神秘之中时，锁链就诞生了。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ041699.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
